robot: Franka Panda on an Omron mobile base with a torso lift (RoboCasa PandaMobile); the arm is driven by robosuite's operational-space controller (end-effector deltas)

frame.suite: the RoboCasa kitchen's world frame (metres, z up)
frame.base_text: the mobile base's starting placement: on the floor at the base's origin, +X the way the arm faces, +Y the robot's left, +Z up; it stays where the base started (driving the base does not move this frame)

arm.note: Panda arm under robosuite's OSC_POSE controller (end-effector deltas in the robot base frame): move_robot reaches a hand position by repeated measured steps; the hand's orientation is not measured. The gripper is open or closed only.

ee_delta.point: the gripper's grip site, between the fingertips
ee_delta.note: execute_trajectory space ee_delta: each row is one 0.05 s step; dpos (m) and drot (rad, rotation vector) move the hand's target from the measured hand pose by that much in that step (at most 0.05 m and 0.5 rad); the hand covers only part of it within the step. The hand's orientation is not measured: move_robot takes positions.

notes: The arm, the base and the torso lift take one action type, ee_delta (12 numbers, one row per 0.05 s control step), sent with execute_trajectory space native, action_type ee_delta: arm_dx, arm_dy, arm_dz, arm_drx, arm_dry, arm_drz move the hand's target from the measured hand pose by 0.05 m / 0.5 rad per unit in that step, in the robot base frame (+x the way the arm faces, +y left, +z up; axis-angle rotation); grip +1 closes, -1 opens; base_x, base_y (1.0 = 1 m/s) and base_yaw (1.0 = 1.5 rad/s) are the mobile base's velocity targets in its own frame; torso moves the lift's height target by 0.05 m per unit per step (range 0 to 0.34 m); hybrid_mode -1 (the default) keeps the arm's goal fixed while the base moves. Each value is clipped to [-1, 1]; a row of zeros with grip and hybrid_mode as they are holds the robot. proprio_now has eef_right_x/y/z (the grip site's position in the world frame), the joints (robot0_joint1..7, the mobile base's mobilebase0_joint_mobile_forward/side/yaw and the torso's mobilebase0_joint_torso_height) and cmd_* (the last command). The poses the tools report are in the base's starting placement. The cameras ride on the robot; each frame comes with its current calibration.
